howto.name: PrivaTools encodes via FFmpeg
howto.text: Encoded straight from uncompressed source, so quality is as good as the chosen bitrate allows.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Ogg Vorbis is patent-free and a good fit for games and web audio, encoded here straight from uncompressed source so quality is as good as the bitrate allows.

faq.a: OGG Vorbis produces small, good-quality lossy files in a royalty-free format — handy for games, web audio, and open-source projects, and far smaller than WAV.
OGG Vorbis here is lossy; pick a quality level that balances size and fidelity. For lossless, use WAV→FLAC instead.
